name: Human school homepage on mobile
description: Checks the public homepage presents the full human school website structure on a mobile viewport.
expected: The homepage has the school header, hero, About, Why Choose, News & Events, Academics, School Life, Admissions, Gallery, Contact and footer sections.

name: Student portal behaves like a portal
description: Checks the student portal has a real dashboard structure and portal navigation.
expected: The student portal shows dashboard cards, portal navigation, curriculum controls and the 18 AI teacher grid.

name: Parent portal behaves like a portal
description: Checks parents have a separate portal workspace.
expected: The parent portal shows family-oriented dashboard cards and navigation for children, results, attendance, fees, timetable and messages.

name: Inter-class sports only
description: Checks sports are described as class-based competition.
expected: The website explicitly describes inter-class sports and does not introduce house competition.

name: Admin-managed images
description: Checks image slots use published Supabase media and do not introduce stock image URLs.
steps: Publish an image in the Supabase gallery
expected: Published gallery media appears in the appropriate hero, school-life, school campus, news or gallery positions.
